policy_notes: SEC filings and company-filed exhibits lead financial, control and concentration claims.
Material restatement and material weakness are treated as accounting-reliability evidence, not proof of intentional misconduct.
Securities litigation is treated as allegation unless independently adjudicated or admitted.
Management guidance, capacity goals, 800V sampling and planned GlobalFoundries production are forward-looking/pre-production evidence rather than realized cash flows.
Competitor claims are used as counter-evidence and not as independently verified market-share facts.
Secondary market price is a valuation reference, not an execution guarantee.
